claims: The Federal Register release explicitly lists XRP among digital commodities.
Digital commodities are not themselves securities under the interpretation.

The release says its interpretation does not supersede Howey precedent and may be refined based on comments.

claims: SEC issued the interpretation and CFTC joined to administer the Commodity Exchange Act consistently with it.
limitations: Press release summarizes the interpretation; Federal Register text controls detail.
